Standard-library rational checks cover 148 sharp witnesses, 2040 endpoint choices, 21000 rational node families and 120 positive exact moment representations; these tests are supplementary, not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Positive moment-exact weights on externally sampled nodes are central to stable numerical integration; fixed-node existence does not answer whether a stratified sampling design guarantees feasibility for every possible realized position. The exact universal admissible variance range, parity asymmetry, and sharp five-sample deterministic cutoff resolve a natural sampling-design threshold and expose limits near concentrated or endpoint-heavy target laws. This is a complete natural classification, not a new numerical evaluation of a known fixed-node rule.
